rows.name: Army of Allah
rows.review: The six exact-printing scans show a straight macron above o, rather than the canonical artist name’s tilde. Physical printed credit is independent of canonical provider identity and wording mode. Native prototypes use the existing documented serif fallback for the absent MPlantin macron glyph.
